rmpp setup

1Connect to the tablet

Turn on developer mode on the tablet, connect it with USB (or use its Wi-Fi address).

Shown on the tablet: Settings › General › Help › About › Copyrights and licenses. Needed once; then a key is used.

Advanced

Empty: the app's own key (made on first use, also used by the install scripts). Another key must have no passphrase.

2Choose mods

The reMarkable OS was updated: the mods' system files need restoring.
Vellum (the package manager) is not on the tablet yet: installing sets it up first.
    The tablet's screen restarts once or twice while installing.
    Remove everything

    Removes all rmpp mods from the tablet, then rmpp-preload and this package repository. Packages from other repositories stay, and so do rmpp-preload and Vellum while they need them.

    After a factory reset the add-ons' system files stay (a reset only wipes /home, Vellum included), and xochitl keeps loading them. This removes every rmpp system file whose package is not installed.
